{{Quote|He obtained the coordinates of a secret hyperspace lane known as the Nexus Route, which travels into the heart of both the Republic and Separatist homeworlds.''"<br />"''They could prove vital in maneuvering our forces deep into remote Separatist sectors.''"<br />"''Or the enemy could use them to slip through our defenses and attack Coruscant.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="The Citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Nexus Route''' was a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace corridor]]<ref name="FF91">{{FactFile2014|91|DOO 11-14|Count Dooku}}</ref> that connected the core territories of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] via a route through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Its coordinates were obtained by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and were of strategic interest to both sides of the conflict. As the hyperspace route traveled into the hearts of both the Republic and Separatist [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]], the Nexus Route had the potential to tip the scale of the war in the favor of whichever side possessed its coordinates. While returning from the Outer Rim, Piell's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] was [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|boarded]] by the Separatists. Piell erased the coordinates from the ship's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and memorized one half of the coordinates, while [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], memorized the other. The [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and his crew were subsequently captured and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], to be [[Torture/Legends|interrogated]] for the Nexus Route's coordinates.<ref name="The Citadel" /> Though the Republic launched a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission]] to rescue Piell and his forces, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] before he could escape. However, he entrusted his half of the data to [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] before he passed, demanding that she deliver the information to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. Tarkin, meanwhile, refused to give his half of the data to anyone other than [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], with whom [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] would confer to decide on the best course of action.<ref name="Citadel Rescue">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>

During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious provided Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] with the coordinates<ref name="FF86">{{FactFile2014|86|GRI 13-16|General Grievous}}</ref> for the Nexus Route, allowing his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to jump from the Outer Rim to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="FF91" /> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> and [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|kidnap]] Chancellor Palpatine.<ref name="FF91" />
